source.quote_free_summary: Conflicts (judging an immediate family member, current spouse/significant other, established dance partner or current business partner) must be identified and avoided; judges and chief judges recuse. Exceptions (i) Pro-Am Jack and Jill/Strictly Swing judging Amateurs when the conflict is with the Pro, (ii) opposite role in Jack and Jill preliminaries, (iii) self-judging in Champions/invitational contests; (iv) is a chief-judge substitution.

requirement: Judge-declared conflicts and identity checks block; exceptions i-iii only through a documented resolution (slice 3), not in slice 1.
interpretation_notes: No conflict mechanism exists today (audit J-16W). The pinned text lists four exception sub-items; the audit said three. WSDC enforces only the 3.4.6.a definition (3.4.6.a.i). Design only (PR-A): nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
